notes.title: Big News for 2025
notes.content:
[p]Dear friends of video games, 

It has been almost a year since the last update, and unfortunately, there were a few personal reasons for this. 

However, I can now proudly announce that it will not be long until a major update is released. Stay tuned and be ready for another era of Light and Shadow - Shadows over Empyria.

Best regards,
RPGStudios[/p]

notes.title: Price cut while Early Access
notes.content:
Dear players,

I would like to inform you that the price of the game has been reduced for the remainder of the Early Access phase, until the story is complete. After that, the price will revert to the previous price and may increase with further content.

Take advantage of this opportunity to add the game to your library while this price exists.

Best regards, 
Kevin Frohn 
RPGStudios

notes.title: Full translation for english available NOW!
notes.content:
Dear players,

the time has finally come! Light and Shadow - Shadows over Empyria has now been fully translated into English and all future updates will be available in German and English at the same time. 
This means that every further update, no matter if bugfix or new feature, will be available directly for both languages.

Look forward to future updates for Light and Shadow - Shadows over Empyria and cheers to all the players who have accompanied me on this long journey with this game!

If you notice anything during your adventure that shouldn't be there (you're stuck, a mission is buggy, etc.), feel free to mention it in the reviews or contact me directly.
Your wishes and criticisms will be heard.

Thank you very much and have a nice weekend!
RPGStudios

notes.title: Partial Translation into English
notes.content:
The game has now been further translated into the English language so that players can enjoy more of Light and Shadow - Shadows over Empyria. Efforts are being made at full speed to fully translate the game, and it won't take much longer.

I thank you for your understanding!

notes.title: Beware of keyseller sites!
notes.content:
Dear players,

During research, several keyseller sites have been noticed trying to sell the game in an [b]unauthorized[/b] manner as a key. Among them are Kinguin, G2 Play and G2A.

All unredeemed keys have been [b]irreversibly[/b] blocked. Keys that have already been redeemed will remain accessible out of goodwill.

I would like to point out once again that I am currently not working with [b]any store or reseller[/b], and there are no keys transmitted by me through them. Be careful out there!

I wish you continued enjoyment with Light and Shadow - Shadows over Empyria!

[b]Short announcement:[/b] At the end of May, the roadmap for the game will be presented, giving you direct insights into upcoming elements of the game. Stay tuned!

[b]Brief information about the translation process of the English version:[/b] The game is developed and distributed by a single person. Therefore, due to time constraints, there may be delays. Every effort is being made to fully translate the game to the currently playable state by May 10th. Consequently, the deadline unfortunately has to be postponed from the end of April to May 10, 2024. Thank you for your understanding!

notes.title: English Version officially playable!
notes.content:
It’s finally here: The game is now also playable in its English version! To do this, simply set the language to English in the game properties on Steam.

Information regarding your game progress: If your save files have disappeared due to recent updates: Navigate to the Light and Shadow folder in your SteamApps directory -> www -> and copy your ‘saves’ folder as a backup, especially since there’s no cloud storage yet. After each update, simply place this folder back into the ‘www’ directory of the game, if you are among those affected!

If any of you have experienced issues with your save files, I apologize! The aforementioned steps should prevent this problem from occurring again!

notes.title: Overview of the next Update
notes.content:
Light and Shadow - Shadows over Empyria will receive an English-language version in the next update and will thus leave the German-exclusive version.

In addition, the next update, which will be released after the English version, will have the following new content:

[list]
[*] More lively forest town: The town on the 1st island will be more lively than ever and will have new characters as well as more walk-in options
[*] New story section: There will be more story elements in the game to bring the world to life.
[/list]

Please understand that Light and Shadow - Shadows over Empyria is a 1-developer game and it may take some time for new and innovative content to be added to the game.

The target for the English language update is currently the end of April. Subject to change.

The game is being improved under high pressure and listens to the community. 
In the meantime, if you think of something you would like to see in the game, please let us know! We will consider whether and how we can incorporate the requested content into the game.

Have a nice rest of the weekend!
